newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-LTDI seen ripe for "sell".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-LTDI seen ripe for "sell".

text.p: Philippine brokerage firm Angping Securities recommended to its clients on Tuesday to take profits on liquor maker La Tondena Distillers Inc (LTDI).
"We feel that the stock has reached high valuation at 30.6 times its projected PE this year at its current price of 38.50 pesos," analyst Warren Chua said.
Angping Securities said in a research paper La Tondena has reached "overbought region."
La Tondena reached an all time high of 63 pesos last October 28, Chua said.
Net income of La Tondena from operations in the first nine months of the year slipped to 343.1 million pesos from the year-ago 356 million, he said.
